# Davy Keith

- **Age:** Seven to eight years old  <sub>[v2 c1 P31](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0031), [v2 c7 P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 c10 P0](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0000), [v2 c27 P0](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0000)</sub>

- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v2 c27 P0](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** East Grafton  <sub>[v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Davy is a handsome, chubby boy with a round face, a snub nose, and a crop of fuzzy yellow ringlets all over his head. He has roguish, dancing blue eyes and a single dimple in one cheek that gives him a comical, lopsided look when he laughs. He is broad-shouldered for his age, with fat legs and a appetite that keeps him perpetually hungry.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006), [v2 c8 P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003), [v2 c8 P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P53](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0053), [v2 c10 P53](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0053), [v2 c16 P0](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0000), [v2 c25 P43](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0043)_

## Personality

Davy is an energetic, irrepressible boy who is constantly full of mischief and curiosity. He has an insatiable habit of asking endless questions about everything he encounters. Though prone to telling falsehoods and playing pranks, he possesses a warm, affectionate heart and a strong desire to be loved. He is intensely competitive, especially regarding Paul Irving, but learns to strive toward self-improvement.

_Sources: [v2 c7 P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P54](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0054), [v2 c10 P48](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0048), [v2 c10 P52](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0052), [v2 c10 P58](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0058), [v2 c10 P90](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0090), [v2 c27 P5](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0005)_

## History

Davy Keith and his twin sister Dora were orphaned in East Grafton when their mother passed away. Because their uncle in British Columbia could not immediately care for them, Marilla Cuthbert brought them to live at Green Gables. Davy quickly established a reputation for endless pranks and unruly behavior, such as dropping a caterpillar down a girl's neck in church, tricking his sister into a pigpen, and putting a toad in Marilla's bed. After shutting Dora in Mr. Harrison's toolhouse and lying about her whereabouts, Davy was brought to tears by Anne Shirley's grief and promised never to tell a falsehood again. He entered Avonlea School under Anne's tutelage, where he gradually learned better manners and strived to emulate his rival, Paul Irving. Following the death of his uncle Richard, a trust fund was established for Davy and Dora, securing their permanent home at Green Gables.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c7 P25](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0025), [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000), [v2 c8 P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 c8 P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 c8 P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060), [v2 c10 P35](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0035), [v2 c10 P52](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0052), [v2 c10 P56](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0056), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v2 c22 P23](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0023)_

- Orphaned after his father died in his infancy and his mother passed away from a long illness  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c7 P23](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0023), [v2 c8 P8](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0008)</sub>
